the complex and often messy ways that the mhGAP intervention guide is used in training, and how these uses are shaped by local epistemologies of mental health.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mhGAP intervention guide and its training is not a one size fits all tool.
the mhGAP intervention guide is not a simple top down tool that is used in a linear fashion to medicalize mental health.
the mhGAP is not simply an instrument for medicalization, but rather that it is a tool for the creation of a new global mental health order, which is enacted in local contexts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mhGAP training is a dynamic and flexible process, which can be shaped and adapted to local contexts.
mhGAP is not a one size fits all tool, and the training of mhGAP is an important site for exploring how universal tools are used, enacted, and adapted.
the mhGAP intervention guide is not a tool that can be used in any situation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mhGAP training is more than just a set of instructions for how to do mental health.
the mhGAP intervention guide is not a static tool, but one that has the capacity to change and evolve as a result of the people involved in its delivery and use.
the mhGAP intervention guide, while designed for universal use, does not enact the same pedagogic modes in all places.
